title: 09/11/2026 - Software Updates
text:
## 09/11/2026 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000109712
We made updates to several default widgets this week. If you customized any of these widgets and want to update them, you can find the latest code in the corresponding default widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, the latest updates will not be pushed to your website.
Improved the Activity Tracker in the Admin so it now records which admin added, edited or removed a form field, and which admin changed an admin account password.
Improved front-end page loading speed by removing a duplicate download of a JavaScript file that every page was requesting twice. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD
Fixed an issue that prevented company member listings from being found when searching for their full name, in cases where the name was stored across the First Name and Last Name fields.
Fixed an issue that caused the website search to ignore the content of posts when the Post Keyword Search Options setting had never been saved for a post type, even though the post type settings screen displayed "Search Default Fields + Custom Fields" as the selected option. This applies to websites with the Search Members Keywords Add-On active.
Fixed an issue that prevented non-image files from displaying an icon in the grid view of the Media Manager in the Admin.
Fixed an issue that caused the Home link in the breadcrumb navigation to point to an incorrect website address in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Display Breadcrumbs
Fixed an issue that caused member profile pages to publish a 5-star rating from one review in their structured data when the listing had no reviews at all. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Contact Page Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Display Member Address Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Read Review Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Submit Review
Fixed an issue that prevented all API delete requests from reaching the API on websites that renamed the "Member Dashboard URL: Delete Post" Advanced Setting, because the request was redirected to the renamed address before the API could process it.
Fixed an issue that caused the "Try it out" tool on the API documentation page in the Admin to send requests to a different address than a real API call, so member images were not imported and the Admin session was signed out each time it was used.
Fixed an issue that prevented the security check from working on any page whose first form was hidden inside an HTML comment by the website theme, which displayed the message "The security check was not completed successfully" when visitors tried to register. In addition, the "Processing Request..." message no longer remains on screen when a form is submitted twice in quick succession. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Form
Applied a security update to the lead request forms on the website.
Fixed an issue that prevented members imported with the Business Data tool from appearing in location searches on non-US websites, because the full state or province name was saved instead of its two-letter code.
Fixed an issue that caused a second Members Export to download the first export's file instead of a new file, when both exports were run without reloading the page. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Manage Digital Products
Fixed an issue that caused a member's own social media links to be published as the website's official social media profiles in the structured data of the member's reviews page. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Global Website - Schema Markup
Fixed an issue that prevented Vimeo videos from displaying on post pages when the video information could not be retrieved from Vimeo, because the embedded player was built with the video's page address instead of its player address. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Single Post Page
Fixed an issue that caused member photos imported with the "Import All" bulk action on the Member Images page to be saved with a file name that did not match the file actually stored on the website, on websites that convert uploads to WebP.
Fixed an issue that caused the entries loaded by the " Click To Load More Results " button in the Specialties section of a member profile to display without their row styling and with broken links.
Fixed an issue that caused the "Select All" bulk delete on the Manage Posts page in the Admin to report success while deleting nothing, for post types that allow multiple images.
Fixed an issue that prevented tables created with the Froala Editor from stacking correctly on mobile devices when their column widths or height had been adjusted by hand. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD
Fixed an issue that caused the description of members imported with the Business Data tool to be cut off in the middle of a word.
Fixed an issue that caused the security check error message on the login form to remain on screen after the check had already been completed successfully. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Google ReCaptcha on Sign up Page
Fixed an issue that caused underscores to be replaced with hyphens in website addresses, which made the search results page point search engines to an address that returned a Page Not Found error.
